282ddccb781a.text: Chronal integration interrupted. Subject: Vale, Ethan. Synchronisation sixty-one percent.

495da6069417.text: Containment breach, sublevels four through nine. All personnel evacuate.

4a4008481c26.text: Volunteer seven. Mister Vale. You understand nobody can promise you come back the same man.

4498e508e78a.text: I understand. Someone has to go first.

bd5f8cb4a233.text: That was me. I signed up for this?

6b6689725f61.text: All units, sublevel six. Volunteer seven is loose. Containment is your only priority.

f3b12a887fab.text: Contact! Down on the floor, now!

ddfce917e219.text: Warning. Localised temporal discontinuity in lab 04.

1c4fd3ecb8b1.text: That door is cycling faster than anyone could move. Unless...

411aed52aef4.text: Sentinel A-07 authorised. Neutralise the anomaly.

73bfc5215bc5.text: Freight lift two. Ascending to surface level.

e586533decc2.text: Volunteer seven has surfaced. Sector nine. Nobody engages without me.

04643e0a0505.text: Okay. Let's see how far this goes.

09aac137babd.text: The ceiling came down... and stopped. It's just hanging there.

868f657f1b60.text: He's heading for the Engine. Seal the core and put him down.

9cb490d081ae.text: Up. Whatever's up there can't be worse than this.

06576724707a.text: That's not one city. That's all of them.

4253aaac2be2.text: All teams. The anomaly came up on the north stack. He's on the roofs. Box him in.

e6ca6e82c152.text: Down. I need to get down.

f0e2aec1a2d7.text: It's morning on my street and night on the next one. My daughter's school isn't there any more. There's a field. Just a field.

50ee21f239b3.text: If anyone finds this... we went north. Toward the tower. Everyone says it's the only thing that's still the same.

0e1451b0df6a.text: It's not falling. It's just... stopped.

43f68ad5a1f9.text: Don't touch it. Whatever stopped it is still in there.

f819ed54fe10.text: Who is this? How are you on this channel?

6e2be648b5cb.text: Your gauntlet is talking to my rig. That makes you Volunteer Seven. The cafe on the east side, under the green awning. Move.

20793735fc5e.text: Close the door. They track movement, not people.

e9ed861f2bdd.text: I know what you are. I helped build the thing on your arm.

9b5a1e54e042.text: Then tell me what happened down there.

98927db5d9be.text: The Engine was supposed to look. Just look, along the timeline. Instead it pulled. Every version of this city is trying to be it at once.

219cff878821.text: And you are the only thing in it that can push back. Your integration keeps a few seconds of your own past. You can step back into them.

937d7cd108a3.text: Four seconds. Use them well, because HELIX will not give you five.
